verdict.rationale: Isaac ships deployment software for physical robots (Isaac ROS on Jetson, policy deployment bundles), so offline resilience is a fair question for this product. However, no evidence covers continuing operation during cloud outages, local data buffering, or reconnection and recovery behavior. On-device deployment alone does not show buffering or clean recovery.

support.subject: As an ops lead, my robots keep operating and buffer data locally when cloud connectivity drops, then recover cleanly
